title: its a lil big the pack
description: Ideal for builders and adventurers, this pack shines on servers—rewarding teamwork, creativity, and discovery without overwhelming complexity. Build together, explore together, and shape the world your way.
body:
A Fabric 1.20.1 modpack focused on creative engineering and adventurous exploration. Build intricate machines with Create, automate your world, and design impressive bases while setting out to conquer new dimensions like The Twilight Forest.

Designed to be multiplayer-friendly, this pack encourages collaboration between builders and adventurers alike—whether you’re constructing massive factories, exploring dangerous biomes, or progressing together through challenging bosses. Perfect for players who enjoy blending technical creativity with meaningful exploration.
